## M6 Human Handoff
Collects name + phone/email + reason, upserts to Escalations (issue_type=handoff), notifies staff when contact present, texts patient (gated). Promises follow-up but never a specific callback time.
After import: point 'Upsert Escalation'→M7, 'Notify Staff'→M8, 'Send Patient SMS'→M9.

parameters.jsCode: const c = { ...$('Build Reply + Rows').item.json }; delete c._row; delete c._email; delete c._sms; delete c._ready; return { json: c };
